title: Middle Eastern Maqluba Boudin Blanc
description: A twist on traditional maqluba, this Middle Eastern-inspired dish features boudin blanc and a variety of spices.

ingredients.name: blanc vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers

ingredients.name: middle eastern herbs
ingredients.notes: such as parsley, cilantro, and dill

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pita bread and cook until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the pita bread from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and cook the boudin blanc until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the middle eastern spices to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the maqluba sauce to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Add the blanc vegetables to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the middle eastern herbs and lemon juice.
Serve the boudin blanc mixture over the pita bread and top with crumbled feta cheese, if desired.
Garnish with additional middle eastern herbs, if desired.
